_comment: BluePilot Network Settings - WiFi, Tethering, and Cellular management with BP styling

_implementation_notes.wifi_list: Creates BPWifiListControl widget that contains WifiManager instance
_implementation_notes.command_buttons: Use connect_signal to trigger methods on BPWifiListControl (connectHiddenNetwork, scanNetworks, changeTetheringPassword, editApn)
_implementation_notes.wifi_metered: Custom segmented control that interacts directly with WifiManager via NetworkManager (not param-based)
_implementation_notes.signal_connectors: Search up widget tree to find BPWifiListControl for cross-group communication
